description.value: Circle K is a 24-hour gas station and convenience store on Production Way in Burnaby, part of the global Couche-Tard network. It offers ready-to-eat hot food via the Roller Grill and Fresh Food Fast programs, along with coffee and a full convenience selection. Public restrooms are available on-site, making this a functional pit stop for cyclists passing through the Burnaby industrial corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Circle K website confirms an active store at 3292 Production Way, Burnaby, BC V5A 4R4, with phone +16044203161, open 24 hours. Services explicitly listed on the website include Fresh Food Fast, Public Restrooms, Coffee, and Roller Grill, confirming groceries, hot food, and washrooms. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, charging) are mentioned in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the address and coordinates clearly place this store in Burnaby — likely a data entry error in OSM.
Circle K's own website header incorrectly labels the country as 'United States' for this Canadian address; the postal code (V5A 4R4) and province code (CA) confirm it is in Canada.
OSM has no phone or street address on record; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active 24-hour convenience store with confirmed restrooms and hot food; useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Burnaby area.
